What is ATA Certified Boston Translation and Interpretation?

The American Translators Association is the organization that identifies individuals who are proficient enough to earn the title of Boston ATA certified translation expert. These individuals have shown the skills needed to accurately translate a document from one language to another, such as English to Japanese or Spanish to English. AET is staffed with experts in translation and interpretation in Boston MA. We know how to accurately translate documents in more than 100 languages, without changing the tone or format.
